source: User Google Drive thesis-code folder and its functions.zip / boundaryImageComparison package
legacy_pipeline: continuous aggregated map -> getBoundaries(map, inf) -> binary boundary map -> ComparisonResiduals('ejBCM-F', ..., 0.025) -> ejmBasedConfusionMatrix -> estradaJepsonMatching v1.00
notes: getBoundaries.m and ComparisonResiduals.m are the user's thesis-era files from the supplied Drive folder.
ejmBasedConfusionMatrix.m is the v1.00 file bundled in functions.zip and is preserved byte-for-byte.

estradaJepsonMatching.bckp.m is the complete v1.00 backup from the thesis/KITT boundaryImageComparison package; Stage 22A copies it byte-for-byte to a run-local estradaJepsonMatching.m alias because MATLAB requires the filename to match the function name.
Third-party license headers are preserved verbatim; vendored third-party files must not be edited.
